rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a swimsuit or swimming costume.

example.english: I forgot to bring my swimming costume to the pool.

rows.note: Use this specifically for swimming trunks or swim shorts, rather than a one-piece swimsuit.

example.english: Marcus bought new swimming costume for the beach.

rows.note: Use this more formal or category-level term when referring to swimwear as a type of clothing.

example.english: The shop has a wide range of swimming costume for this summer.
